_about: The screens Tools/capture_screenshots.py photographs for the help. Each 'key' becomes wwwroot/help/images/.webp and is shown in a topic with . 'who' signs in as staff or as the demo tenant; 'device' is desktop or phone; 'before' is JavaScript run before the picture is taken; each marker puts a numbered call-out on the first element matching its CSS selector, with the label printed under the picture. URLs with record ids assume the demo database.

shots.caption: The dashboard: portfolio, occupancy, collections and receivables at a glance.
The Help button opens the instructions for the screen you are on, beside your work.
The chart of accounts, with the opening-balance check at the top.

markers.label: Green when opening balances agree, red with the difference when not

shots.caption: Account Mapping: which account each automatic posting uses.
The opening balance reconciliation. Net Imbalance must be 0.00.
VAT Settings: your TRN, tax invoice details and the provisional recovery rate.
Period Closing: the twelve monthly periods and their status.
Users and the permissions each one holds.
The property list. Codes are issued by the system.
Adding a property. The code is previewed as you choose ownership and type.
shots.before: (async () => { const o = document.querySelector('#ownershipType'); o.value = 'Owned'; o.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); const t = document.querySelector('#propertyType'); t.value = 'Commercial'; t.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 700)); })()
